card.name: Scattered mid-sentence words in imaging text
card.fires_on: Mostly the word 'different' in the CT scan definition (taken from different angles), plus nearby words in that same stock sentence. Also fires on periods and digits inside citations and phone numbers.

modes.label: CT scan definition
modes.description: Words inside the stock sentence describing a CT scan as pictures taken from different angles.
modes.example: such as the chest, taken from<< different>> angles.

modes.label: Digits and periods in references
modes.description: A period or digit within citations, phone numbers or part numbers.

card.plain: It reacts mainly to one repeated CT scan description, and weakly to odd punctuation and digits in references.
evidence: such as the chest, taken from<< different>> angles.
